summary: The root ردأ (rdA) refers to a very heavy stone, specifically one that a strong man would struggle to lift with both hands. It implies something weighty and difficult to move.
lane: مِرْدَأَةٌ ذ A stone which a strong man can hardly lift with both his hands; (TA;) as also مِرْدَاةٌ . (ISh, TA in art. ردى .)
